caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-length coat or dress with long sleeves, rendered predominantly in shades of gray and black. The main garment is light gray with contrasting black accents on the upper shoulders, collar, cuffs, and triangular panels along the sides of the skirt. Decorative black scrollwork embellishments are present on the left front bodice, the lower sleeves, and as a large motif extending downward along the left front panel of the skirt. The outfit features a high collar with an additional pointed flap and a row of buttons running down the center front. The garment flares below the hips, suggesting a fitted bodice and a wide, flowing skirt. To the right of the main illustration, there is a smaller, outlined sketch of the back view of the garment, showing a similar flared skirt, long sleeves, high collar, and some of the same seamed detailing but with less ornamentation. The drawing is done on cream-colored paper. There is a handwritten note at the bottom right corner indicating the artist's name and the association with the Federal Art Project.
title: Suit (Costume)
